title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Salle Des Etoiles, Monte Carlo | 2018
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Salle Des Etoiles Sporting Club in Monte Carlo, Monaco, on 6 July 2018.

Wow we even got the Monaco crowd up. on their feet what a great night peace and love everybody ???????????

— #RingoStarr (@ringostarrmusic) July 7, 2018

It was the 20th show of the 13th All-Starr Band’s tour of Europe and North America, which lasted for 44 dates between June and September 2018.

Starr had previously performed at the Salle Des Etoiles on 28, 29, and 30 August 1998.

The 13th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar, harmonica
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, keyboards
  • Graham Gouldman: vocals, bass guitar, acoustic guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet

They were joined by Joe Walsh during the performance of ‘With A Little Help From My Friends’.
